title: How Far Does a Fit-Free GPU-Efficiency Model Travel Across Model Families?
summary_zh: 一項有界的可移植性研究，檢驗一個 fit-free 的 decode 延遲機制模型能跨越多遠的模型家族。凍結效率常數、僅替換架構形狀，GPU 計算形狀轉移至 Qwen2.5-7B 達 5.5% 整體殘差（低於 anchor 的 8.4%）。但絕對延遲無法 fit-free 轉移，因為 host 基準取決於模型大小：將 anchor 的 A100 偏移套用至 Llama-3.2-1B 使誤差從 48.5% 惡化至 71.2%。MoE（Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B）dispatch 項微不足道（0.004 ms），但有一個未建模、高於 dense +18 ms 的 MoE host 基準，且長 context cell 偏離 34.6%。一張有界的可移植性地圖，而非「fit-free 成立」。
summary_en: A bounded transferability study of how far a fit-free decode-latency mechanism model travels across model families. Freezing the efficiency constants and swapping only the architecture shape, the GPU-compute shape transfers to Qwen2.5-7B at 5.5% pooled residual (below the anchor's 8.4%). But absolute latency does not transfer fit-free, because the host floor is model-size-dependent: applying the anchor's A100 offset to Llama-3.2-1B worsens its error from 48.5% to 71.2%. For MoE (Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B) the dispatch term is negligible (0.004 ms), but a MoE host floor of +18 ms above dense is unmodeled and the long-context cell is 34.6% off. A bounded map, not a claim that fit-free works.
